hints.title: Start Position Constraint
hints.text: The knight must start at the top-left cell, so if grid[0][0] differs from 0, the tour is immediately invalid.

hints.title: Index by Step Number
hints.text: Record the (row, col) coordinates for each move number from 0 to n^2 - 1.

hints.title: L-Shape Jump Verification
hints.text: For each consecutive step k and k + 1, check that (|r[k+1] - r[k]|, |c[k+1] - c[k]|) equals either (1, 2) or (2, 1).

hints.title: Sequential Knight Step Verification Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass indexing all n^2 positions and linear verification of consecutive moves.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching the entire grid for each step value takes O(n^4).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) array mapping step numbers to grid coordinates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Checks grid[0][0] == 0 and validates valid knight move offsets.
